customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of my lease - Lindenstrasse 6, Baden
customer_message.body: Dear Legal Expenses Team, I am writing to ask for your help in contesting the termination of my lease for the 3-room flat at Lindenstrasse 6 in Baden. My landlord, Wohnbau Limmat GmbH, has given me a written notice of termination of the lease. I have received this notice and I would like to understand my options and whether it can be challenged. I would like your advice on how to respond to the notice and which deadlines apply. I have the notice in front of me and can provide a copy if you need it. I also wonder whether the termination could be a reaction to something I raised with the landlord earlier. I have not made up my mind on this and I am not sure whether there is a connection. I would like a professional assessment of this point before I decide how to proceed. Please let me know which documents you need from me and whether you can arrange a consultation. You can reach me by e-mail or by phone. Kind regards, Sam Whitfield
